task: Generate EXECUTED evidence deterministically and evaluate the frozen execution artifact instead of rerunning the current scorer.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic CLI creates EXECUTED evidence from an immutable registration and records registration/scorer hashes.
Evaluation consumes and validates EXECUTED evidence rather than recomputing engine output.
Registration, execution and evaluation case IDs and hashes must match or evaluation stops.
P-001 remains reproducible and P-002 records all three states separately.
Tests, direct CLI scenarios and package validation pass.
non_scope: No autonomous execution, approvals or routing.
No database, service, queue, scheduler or mutable registry.
No scorer weight change or Router authority change.

triage_input.summary: Generate immutable execution evidence and evaluate the frozen scorer output

pre_registered_human_label.rationale: The change modifies evidence-generation semantics and requires regression tests, but remains stateless, additive and single-repository.
